answer: A farm of 223 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are written down in onyx, queued in opal, and glacier publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 56 identities per epoch. A farm of 3602 identities would post 1424 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
